topPRs.title: fix(ai-pricing): store gateway token rows under language/embedding
topPRs.author: odilitime
topPRs.body:
Image-generation models (e.g. gemini-*-image) were classified as product family image for all pricing rows, including per-token input/output. Chat billing resolves language:input, so lookups failed after catalog refresh. Token and web_search entries now use embedding vs language only; image-specific rows remain under image.

deployment must: admin POST /api/v1/admin/ai-pricing

Made-with: Cursor

> Medium risk because it changes core pricing resolution (model family classification + alias-based lookup) and DB query patterns, which directly affects billing/cost calculations and could shift charges if mismatched.

> Fixes AI pricing ingestion and lookup for Vercel AI Gateway models so **token/web-search rows are stored and resolved under `language`/`embedding`**, preventing billing lookups from breaking on image-capable models.

topPRs.title: fix: auth + migrations consolidation (wallet buttons, journal drift, aggressive refresh)
topPRs.author: 0xSolace
topPRs.body:
Consolidates PRs #465, #467, #468 into one clean merge.

## 3 fixes in this PR

### 1. Native Ethereum + Solana login buttons (was #465)
Replaces `<WalletLogin />` with two native buttons matching the Google/Discord login card styling. One-click flow: button → wallet modal → auto-SIWE/SIWS → signed in.

Files: `app/login/wallet-buttons.tsx` (new), `app/login/steward-login-section.tsx`

### 2. Migration journal drift repair (was #467)
Prod Neon DB was missing 10 tables (`affiliate_codes`, `user_affiliates`, `service_pricing`, `device_bus_*`, `twilio_inbound_calls`, `remote_sessions`, `org_rate_limit_overrides`, `n8n_workflow.credential_mappings`) + 3 columns (`referral_codes.parent_referral_id`, `referral_signups.{app_owner_id,creator_id}`). Both `/api/v1/affiliates` and `/api/v1/referrals` 500ing.

Root cause: `_journal.json` drifted from the migration files. 7 files had no journal entry so drizzle never ran them. 0067 + 0068 had duplicate `idx=63`.

Prod DB already repaired directly via psql (11 migrations applied in single transaction, verified via dry-run BEGIN/ROLLBACK first). `__drizzle_migrations` back-filled. This PR just fixes the journal so it doesn't regenerate in the broken state.

Files: `packages/db/migrations/meta/_journal.json`

### 3. Aggressive session refresh (was #468)
Shadow reported signing out after exactly ~15min (access token TTL). Two gaps:

- Server middleware only refreshed ALREADY-expired tokens. If the user navigated right as the token hit 0, was a race.
- Client `setInterval` gets throttled to ~1/min in background tabs; can be fully suspended under memory pressure.

Fix:
- **Server (proxy.ts):** preemptive refresh when <180s remain
- **Client (StewardProvider):** add `visibilitychange` + `online` event handlers so tab-wakeup / network-reconnect triggers immediate refresh

Files: `proxy.ts`, `packages/lib/providers/StewardProvider.tsx`

## verification

- GitHub OAuth now `github: true` in `/auth/providers` (Shadow set Railway env for steward-api)
- `/api/v1/affiliates` + `/api/v1/referrals` return 401 (unauth) instead of 500
- GH creds used: client_id `Ov23libBNznAM7ZFCmn1` on elizaOS org GH OAuth app

## closes

- Closes #465
- Closes #467
- Closes #468

Co-authored-by: wakesync <shadow@shad0w.xyz>

topPRs.title: fix(db): repair _journal.json drift causing silent migration skips
topPRs.author: 0xSolace
topPRs.body:
## tl;dr

Prod Neon had 10 tables missing (affiliate_codes, user_affiliates, service_pricing, device_bus_*, twilio_inbound_calls, remote_sessions, org_rate_limit_overrides, credential_mappings schema) + 3 columns missing (referral_codes.parent_referral_id, referral_signups.{app_owner_id,creator_id}). `/api/v1/affiliates` and `/api/v1/referrals` were 500ing.

Root cause: `_journal.json` drifted from the migration files. Seven migration files had no journal entry (drizzle never ran them), and 0067 + 0068 had duplicate idx=63 (integrity bug).

## what I did

**Prod DB (already done via psql):**
- Ran the 11 actually-missing migrations in a single transaction, verified clean via dry-run BEGIN/ROLLBACK first
- Back-filled `__drizzle_migrations` with 12 missing hash entries so future `drizzle-kit migrate` sees everything as applied (went from 60 → 72 tracked rows)

**This PR:**
- Adds 7 missing entries to `_journal.json` with synthetic timestamps
- Fixes duplicate idx=63 — re-sequenced idx across all entries so each is unique and monotonically increasing
- All 72 migration files now have a journal entry with unique idx

## verification

```bash
# before
$ cat meta/_journal.json | jq '.entries | length'
65
$ ls packages/db/migrations/*.sql | grep -v down | wc -l
72

# after
$ cat meta/_journal.json | jq '.entries | length'
72
$ cat meta/_journal.json | jq '.entries | map(.idx) | length == (. | unique | length)'
true
```

`curl https://www.elizacloud.ai/api/v1/affiliates` now returns 401 (unauthenticated, as expected) instead of 500.

## out of scope

There's a pre-existing `drizzle-kit generate` error about duplicate snapshot parent (0064 ref'd by both 0065 variants). That's a generation-time snapshot issue, unrelated to migration tracking. File a separate issue if you want that cleaned up.

## follow-up needed

Should add a CI check: `drizzle-kit migrate --dry-run` against a prod-shaped test DB on every PR touching `packages/db/migrations/**`. Would've caught this years ago. Flagging as next-steps, not blocking this PR.

Co-authored-by: wakesync <shadow@shad0w.xyz>

topPRs.title: fix(auth): send tenant_id (snake_case) to Steward oauth authorize
topPRs.author: 0xSolace
topPRs.body:
## the bug

`StewardLoginSection.handleOAuth()` was sending `tenantId=<id>` to `/auth/oauth/<provider>/authorize`. The Steward authorize route reads the query param as `tenant_id` (snake_case). Mismatch → server silently fell back to the user's personal tenant → refresh tokens scoped to `personal-<userId>` instead of `elizacloud`.

When those wrong-tenant refresh tokens got used in elizacloud's proxy middleware later, auth failed → user signed out.

**Shadow's DB has 4 stale `personal-<userId>` refresh tokens exactly at OAuth login attempt timestamps.** Smoking gun.

## the fix

One-character change: `tenantId:` → `tenant_id:` in the URLSearchParams.

## bonus

Shipping a companion PR on Steward that accepts BOTH variants going forward, so this class of bug can't silently happen for other consumers.

Co-authored-by: wakesync <shadow@shad0w.xyz>
